title: Added Foods Revitalized
description: Rebirth of the Added Foods mod. We are the same developer and plan to bring the mod back to life.
body:
Added Foods Revitalized

Spice up your survival!
Added Foods Revitalized brings a splash of color, flavor, and creativity to your Minecraft world with an ever-growing menu of fun and unique foods to craft, collect, and enjoy.

Whether you're a master chef, an adventurous explorer, or just tired of eating bread for the hundredth time — this mod adds fresh, flavorful options to make your journey tastier than ever.

🍉 A Tastier Minecraft Awaits

Dive into a world where simple ingredients become exciting new dishes. Mix, craft, and experiment with a variety of flavorful treats designed to brighten your inventory and fuel your adventures.

From jiggly jellos to plant-powered creations, every new food brings a touch of personality to your playthrough.

🌈 Vibrant, Fun, and Full of Character

Colorful desserts that bounce with personality

Nature-inspired meals perfect for vegetarian or peaceful runs

Whimsical ingredients that spark creativity

Foods that feel right at home in the Minecraft universe

This is the perfect mod for players who love collecting, crafting, and discovering delightful new items.

🚀 Built to Grow

Added Foods Revitalized is designed with expansion in mind. New foods, new ideas, and new flavors will continue to be added over time — many inspired directly by community suggestions.

If you’ve ever thought “Minecraft needs this food item…” — now’s your chance to make it happen.

💬 Join the Table

Try the mod, taste the new treats, and let your creativity lead the way.
Your suggestions help shape the menu — and there’s always room for more on the plate.
